assignment_binding.selection_mode: existing O_OPERATIONS read-only behavior selected unchanged for Phase 1
assignment_binding.reason_no_o_operations_mutation_required: The Phase-1 assignment selects the existing human-request freshness/change-detection behavior without changing role scope, method, write authority, notification semantics, or continuation. O_CHAT_PARALLEL is the optimizer portfolio control and explicitly carries the Phase-1 task identity for this selected-existing behavior.

scope_and_truthfulness.claim: This witness proves that Phase-1 selected the existing human-monitor behavior and binds that task identity to one exact durable execution receipt demonstrating the selected behavior.
does_not_claim: that the human-monitor receipt itself contained the Phase-1 task id
that O_OPERATIONS was changed by the optimizer
that any user request was fulfilled or that primary O state was modified
that future monitor runs remain valid without their own durable receipts

phase1_acceptance_use.condition: Integrator/optimizer must read both this witness and the exact cited receipt/blob; if either binding or receipt changes materially, require fresh evidence.
